dedupe_keys.name: offline reinforcement learning dataset from a field deployed variable speed limit control system

description: Yuhang Zhang and colleagues at Vanderbilt University publish operational data from a variable-speed-limit system on Interstate 24 in the United States. The September 2025 ZIP is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. The metadata report about one hundred million samples from 67 controllers in both freeway directions, spanning 9 March 2024 to 9 September 2025, converted to an offline reinforcement-learning format. These observations can evaluate traffic-control policies or calibrate simulated controller behaviour. The deposit describes a field-deployed multi-agent policy, but does not by itself prove that alternative offline policies will be safe or effective in service. State/action definitions, sampling intervals and missing-data handling remain unknown from the public summary. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this archive. Data were not downloaded and no control policy was run.
